Frequently Asked Questions

What is the best title runsheet software for independent landmen?

For automated end-to-end runsheets with exact mineral ownership, TitleDesk ($249/run Web or $199/mo Desktop Agent) and Artificial Landman ($249/run) tie at #1. For manual-entry cloud runsheet worksheets with a PDF abstract splitter, TitleMine offers a $169/mo Landman Runsheet tier; for enterprise subscribers needing instant queries inside a 350M-record hosted corpus, Enverus Courthouse offers Runsheet Assistant.

What columns must a defensible Texas oil and gas runsheet include?

A Texas oil and gas examination runsheet requires chronological ordering by execution/effective or filing date, Instrument Type, Grantor, Grantee, Instrument Date, Filing/Recording Date, Volume/Book & Page or Clerk Document Number, Legal Description (Survey, Abstract, Block, Section, Acres), Granting/Reservation & Depth Clauses, and Examiner Remarks/Curative Flags linked back to the source PDF.
